title: Nohemi O
content: I have always been afraid of death, but around 2018 it got worse. I even had a spiritual encounter with my spiritual guide prior to this experience. I needed help to overcome that fear. The next day I was up at night, lying in my bed, and I still do not know if it was a dream. I went into a state that felt so real, I cannot be sure if I was awake or not. When this experience finished, I woke up. I remember telling my husband I was not sure if it was a vision or a dream. I was in a shower where the water was running in a straight line. There was a bright, strong light entangled with the water that was going down through the drain. I looked at it. My feet were close to the drain, and the moment my toe touched the water, my physical body started dissolving and my soul was slowly becoming part of the light. The moment my toe touched the water, I was quickly shown that I had a husband, my two children, a house, money in my bank account, and my car. Those are the people and things I love the most and care a lot about to this day. I was very attached to the material things. This was like a quick view of what I had in the temporal realm, and I was so scared of leaving them if I were to die. At the same moment, I felt all these amazing feelings that there are no words to describe because they do not exist in the physical realm. These feelings are beyond love, happiness, and joy. The physical pain was gone and the fear was gone. I felt that I did not care if I was leaving the physical realm and leaving all my loved ones and material stuff behind. I felt I did not want to come back. But, it was like I knew I had to come back, so it was not difficult to return. I just came back. These indescribable feelings were beyond anything we feel on earth. For a couple of days, I was in this amazing state, but then it slowly started fading. I know what we feel when we die, even though I did not die. I am not scared anymore, but I still do not want to die yet. After that happened, I told my husband, my mother, and my sister. My mother is Catholic and to me to go see a priest. I didn't do that because I do not trust them. My sister is a Christian devoted to God. She gave me her advice and told me to look for other people who have experienced what I did. I told her I had already done that and had looked on the internet for similar experiences, but nothing had popped up. She didn't know what else I could do. I thought I would continue with my life, and maybe one day I would find someone with a similar experience. For some reason, yesterday, a podcast popped up from the show talking about a lady who was struck by lightning many years ago. She explained the feelings she had when she met God and said there is nothing like it on earth. So I decided to write because, after all these years, finally someone has felt what I felt. The difference is that I was not dead.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, I was awake but went back to sleep., Other (briefly specify), I was scared of dying for years, but it had gotten worse prior to the experience.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I could feel everything in a way we don't feel here in the physical realm.
elements.At what time during the experience were: From the beginning to the end
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Time lost all meaning, but everything seemed to happen so fast.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I could see much more clearly.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, The light was becoming entangled with the water, and I then became part of it.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I became part of the light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt immense love and joy that I can't describe. There was no physical pain and no fears. It's something you can't describe; there are no feelings like that on Earth.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, I felt we are part of the light, the source called God. I know we are here because we all have different paths to grow the soul. We don't have to be scared of losing the physical body. I know the soul does not die. I just know it.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Catholic, I believe there is a God, or as I call it, the source of energy that exists.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths, I continue to believe in God. That has never changed, but I'm more on a spiritual path. I do not see God the way the church has shown us with the Bible. I always questioned the Catholic religion.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I knew we die, but I did not know what you feel afterwards.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I am not afraid of dying, as I was before. It has helped me understand that when we die, we feel amazing. By amazing, I mean that is nothing compared to what we actually feel. It has helped me cope with my father-in-law passing away in February this year. I loved him like a father. I know what he felt when his soul was leaving his physical body, and he is having a blast up there with no more pain.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, We are part of the source of light, which is God.
Uncertain, I know we are part of the light.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, We are all part of the Light.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I felt amazing love when I joined with the light. That kind of feeling does not exist here on earth.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I'm not sure if it was a dream. It felt like a vision, but I'm not sure. Then I woke up, which was the weird part. In this experience, I confirmed my suspicions that my husband and I lived together in another lifetime. I was shown both of us. I felt it was us, but I could not see our faces. I saw us from a far distance away, sitting near a water well. I had a dress from the 1800s; he was helping me get water out of the well. The next day when I woke up, I told my husband that I had a dream or a vision. I told you when we met that I could see through your eyes to your soul and that I felt we were together for 40 years instead of a couple of months. Well, this is a revelation experience. I always felt we have been together in different past lives, but I could not confirm that. After this vision or dream, I have no doubt about it.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I remember it like it was yesterday. The only sad part is that the feeling faded fast. But, now I know what we feel when we die. I am 100 percent sure of it.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, It has happened this year, so I don't know if it is related to my experience. What are the odds of finding you guys and having this power? I control most of my thoughts.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Just knowing that we are part of the light and how we feel after we leave the physical body is so meaningful to me.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I have heard stories of people dying and coming back. I never looked into it.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, Yes, it was real. I am 100 percent sure.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, It is real. I need it to be shown that. I know it, do not ask me how.
